47d828fda096e3b8.column_purpose: Identifier of the TV channel the episode aired on; references TV_Channel.id (e.g. 701, 704, 707 are music-content channels). Stored as text but numeric in the 700s.

bb4c04501133a062.column_purpose: Name of the episode's director (Ben Jones, Brandon Vietti, or Michael Chang).

f3fb07ad60b42c3c.column_purpose: Date the episode first aired, e.g. 'December12,2008' (US format, month name + day + year, stored as text without spaces).

49854f896aac8942.column_purpose: Episode production code, sequential integers 101–112 (season 1, episodes 1–12).

f1437f9ed39d961c.column_purpose: Title of the episode, e.g. 'Day of the Dark Knight!', 'Fall of the Blue Beetle!'.

875e5948f52e319e.column_purpose: Name of the episode's writer(s), e.g. 'J. M. DeMatteis', 'Steven Melching'.

40f230a72924246c.column_purpose: Primary key; sequential episode identifier 1–12. The TV_series table's Share, Rating, and Viewers_m columns appear to reference it (likely per-episode ratings/viewership data), though the exact semantics of that link are not fully evidenced.

9a5b57a4580b3d50.column_purpose: Genre of the channel's content. All rows are 'music', so this catalog holds only music channels.

2cc1439a6acc1891.column_purpose: Country of origin/broadcast of the channel (Italy, United Kingdom, Poland).

76fbd7ca0464a966.column_purpose: Whether the channel broadcasts in high definition ('yes'/'no'). Column name is misspelled ('Hight').

61b1dc551bfb1ff0.column_purpose: Primary broadcast language of the channel (Italian or English).

f12e721f3072ee04.column_purpose: Subscription package the channel belongs to (e.g. 'Sky Famiglia', 'Sky Famiglia + Sky HD') or 'no ( FTV )' meaning free-to-view, i.e. not part of a pay package.

f00d4525720eaee4.column_purpose: Whether the channel is pay-per-view ('yes'/'no'). All rows are 'no'.

5da8c8839604c4f5.column_purpose: Pixel aspect ratio of the broadcast video signal: 4:3, 16:9, or both ('4:3 / 16:9').

55841030f9b602e4.column_purpose: Primary key; channel identifier (numeric, 700-728). Referenced by TV_series.Channel and Cartoon.Channel.

0bf9f25397e822ba.column_purpose: Name of the TV channel (e.g. 'Sky Music', 'MTV Hits', 'Rock TV'). Despite the column name, values are channel names, not series names; unique per row.

4e3e5276a9389c03.column_purpose: Nielsen adults 18-49 demographic rating and share, written as 'rating/share' (e.g. '2.4/6' = 2.4% of the 18-49 demographic watching, 6% of those watching TV at that time).

513de56a656d9392.column_purpose: Original U.S. broadcast date of the episode, stored as formatted text ('Month Day, Year'); all values fall in October-December 2007, a weekly air schedule.

f1722650857003ca.column_purpose: Identifier of the TV channel/network the episode aired on; references TV_Channel.id (values 700-728). The joined lookup table catalogs music TV channels (mostly Italian Sky/MTV music channels), which conflicts with a scripted U.S. drama series airing on NBC, so the exact channel identity is uncertain even though the join itself is valid.

4e8b79ce68d60bc8.column_purpose: Title of the episode; unique per row, matching episode titles of the 2007 series Journeyman.

3effce19fe677918.column_purpose: Overall Nielsen household rating (percentage of households watching), ranging 3.0-5.8. The detected join to Cartoon.id is spurious (coincidental numeric overlap) and should be ignored.

ec8e957552e0f6ec.column_purpose: Overall Nielsen share (percentage of households watching TV at that time that were watching this episode), 5-9. The detected join to Cartoon.id is spurious and should be ignored.

b5aa57b3b4377b87.column_purpose: Number of viewers in millions (4.24-9.16). The detected join to Cartoon.id is spurious and should be ignored.

0bdf031b49435856.column_purpose: Rank of the episode's viewership among all network primetime programs for that week (43-80, lower is better).

8ff6b20a5f2f2e6e.column_purpose: Surrogate primary key, sequential 1-12, one per episode row.
